tickets.title: Prepare guardian nomination and estate document refresh
tickets.text: Update Mira and Jonas Quillwhistle's estate documents to include a guardian nomination for their daughter Lila, trust provisions for a minor child, and updated fiduciary choices, replacing the 2019 documents that predate parenthood.

tickets.title: Prepare life insurance needs analysis
